description: Calculates cell density (cells per mL) from optical density (OD) measurement and dilution factor. Formula: OD × dilution × factor (default 1e9 cells/mL per OD unit, organism-dependent). (cost: 1 credit)

dilution.description: number, required, dilution factor, fold dilution, no default

factor.description: number, optional, cells/mL per OD unit, default 1e9

od.description: number, required, optical density measurement, absorbance units, no default

name: calculate_cell_density
